title: DriverAssist clipboard probe HGLOBAL ownership

contains.const: InitClipboard creates four unique movable memory objects for the four driver-probe clipboard formats

contracts: InitClipboard creates four unique movable memory objects for the four driver-probe clipboard formats
GlobalAlloc failure prevents clipboard probing and still releases every allocated local object
GlobalLock failure prevents clipboard probing and still releases every allocated local object
InitClipboard dereferences a GlobalLock pointer only after the pointer is non-null
SetClipboardData receives one unique HGLOBAL per private probe format
InitClipboard invokes API_GUI_CLIPBOARD only after the dummy clipboard items have been placed
InitClipboard empties the clipboard after the driver probe and before locally freeing the dummy private-format objects
Gui_InitClipboard still observes the same four format markers in the same order
Vista+ clipboard structure probing and retry topology are unchanged
runtime_gates: Vista+ clipboard init smoke proving API_GUI_CLIPBOARD detects the clipboard item length and integrity index
allocation failure injection proving no GlobalLock NULL dereference and all allocated HGLOBALs are freed
clipboard-open retry smoke proving failure to open the clipboard leaves every local HGLOBAL freed
driver clipboard fix smoke proving ordinary clipboard operations still receive the expected integrity correction
